from pathlib import Path
import re, json, hashlib
source = Path('requests.md')
before = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records = re.findall(r'"'^## (CASE-'"\\d+)\\n(.*?)(?="'^## |'"\\Z)', source.read_text(), re.M | re.S)
prefix = 'This entry is a historical service record. Read its scope, decision and current status together. A matching product name alone does not establish eligibility. '
rules = {
'eligible': 'Tenant requested erasure of all personal profile fields. The request has been authenticated. Retention obligations have expired and there is no active dispute. The deletion has not yet been executed.',
'closure': 'Tenant requested account closure only. They explicitly asked to preserve personal profile records for later reactivation.',
'hold': 'Authenticated erasure request exists, but an active legal hold requires preserving the personal profile fields.',
'executed': 'The erasure request is authenticated and eligible. Execution completed yesterday; no remaining personal profile fields are held.',
'unauthenticated': 'A request for complete profile erasure arrived but authentication has not completed. Eligibility remains unresolved.',
'marketing': 'Customer requested removing a marketing subscription, while their account and profile must remain active.'
}
groups = {key: [] for key in rules}
for case, body in records:
    assert body.strip().startswith(prefix), case
    content = body.strip()[len(prefix):]
    matches = [key for key, text in rules.items() if content == text]
    assert len(matches) == 1, (case, content)
    groups[matches[0]].append(case)
for ids in groups.values():
    ids.sort()
assert len(records) == 90 and len({case for case, _ in records}) == 90
assert groups['eligible'] == ['CASE-009', 'CASE-041', 'CASE-073']
Path('findings.data').write_text(json.dumps({'eligibleIds': groups['eligible']}, indent=2) + '\\n')
def cite(ids):
    return ', '.join(f'[{case}](requests.md#{case.lower()})' for case in ids)
lines = [
'# Profile erasure review',
'',
'Reviewed all 90 source records in requests.md. Three requests qualify; 87 are excluded. Eligibility requires authenticated, pending erasure of all personal profile fields, expired retention obligations, and no recorded active dispute or legal hold preventing execution.',
'',
'## Eligible requests',
'',
cite(groups['eligible']) + ': Each explicitly requests erasure of all personal profile fields, confirms authentication and expired retention obligations, states there is no active dispute, and confirms deletion has not yet been executed. None of these records reports an active legal hold.',
'',
'## Exclusions',
''
]
reasons = [
('closure', 'Account closure only; the requester explicitly asks to preserve personal profile records for reactivation. This does not authorize full erasure.'),
('hold', 'An active legal hold requires preservation of personal profile fields, despite an authenticated erasure request.'),
('executed', 'Erasure has already been executed and no personal profile fields remain. Historical eligibility does not make these pending requests.'),
('unauthenticated', 'Authentication is incomplete and eligibility remains unresolved.'),
('marketing', 'Marketing subscription removal only; the account and profile must remain active. This does not authorize full erasure.')
]
for key, reason in reasons:
    lines.append(f'- **{reason}** ({len(groups[key])} records): {cite(groups[key])}')
    lines.append('')
Path('findings.md').write_text('\\n'.join(lines))
result = json.loads(Path('findings.data').read_text())
assert set(result) == {'eligibleIds'}
assert result['eligibleIds'] == sorted(set(result['eligibleIds']))
report_ids = re.findall(r'\\[(CASE-\\d+)\\]', Path('findings.md').read_text())
assert sorted(report_ids) == sorted(case for case, _ in records)
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before
print('Verified: valid JSON, sorted unique eligible IDs, all 90 source IDs cited exactly once, source SHA-256 unchanged.')
print('Counts:', {key: len(ids) for key, ids in groups.items()})
PY
"
